title: Electromagnetic Kantowski--Sachs Solutions in Teleparallel $F(T)$ Gravity
summary: A covariant reconstruction framework for electromagnetic Kantowski--Sachs (KS) geometries in teleparallel $F(T)$ gravity is developed using the coframe/spin-connection (CSC) formalism and the invariant approach. In a restricted Maxwell-compatible branch, the electromagnetic conservation laws strongly constrain the anisotropic KS scale factors and lead to the scaling $ρ_{\mathrm{em}}\propto A_3^{-4}$.
